sys_hub_flow.description: - Asset request (laptop, monitor, specialised tool): the requester's Level 3 manager approves, then the IT Service Desk Manager. - Medical equipment request: the requesting HOD approves, then the Facilities & Operations Manager (biomedical). - Facility / service request: the requester's Level 3 manager (Head Nurse / Ward In-Charge for ward requests), then the Facilities & Operations Manager. - High-value (proposed): above INR 1,00,000 for assets and facility requests, above INR 5,00,000 for medical equipment. The Hospital Administrator and the Billing & Finance Head also approve, in sequence after the normal approver. - Approvers are always the local hospital's own role holders; only the amount changes the chain. - Backup when the approver is on leave: the next level up in the same reporting line (Level 3 manager > Hospital Administrator / Medical Director / Nursing Superintendent). The Billing & Finance Head's backup is the Hospital Administrator.
